1.title: Texas and Florida Draw Up Terrorism Lists and Take Aim at a Muslim Group
1.summary: The federal government designates terrorism groups. But Governors Ron DeSantis and Greg Abbott have gotten in the game, and a focus is CAIR, a nonprofit.

2.title: How the Pro-Trump Media Ecosystem Is Splintering Ahead of the Midterms
2.summary: Once united in support of President Trump, right-wing influencers are embroiled in feuds and losing viewers, creating a problem for Republicans in the midterm elections.

3.title: Fauci on 'solid legal ground' in face of prosecution threat, lawyer says
3.summary: The US medical expert faces possible contempt-of-Congress proceedings for refusing to answer questions during a hearing on Covid.

4.title: Selling Burritos Back to Mexico: Chipotle’s Bold Expansion
4.summary: As the Mexican-inspired American chain makes its debut in Mexico, it faces a major hurdle: convincing Mexicans to buy an Americanized take on their own national cuisine.

5.title: Live Updates: Spanish Leader Rushes to Ceuta After Thousands of Migrants Burst Into Territory
5.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez arrived in Ceuta, a Spanish exclave in North Africa, amid an escalating crisis for his pro-immigration government.

6.title: About 49,000 migrants enter Spanish territory of Ceuta in 24 hours, officials say
6.summary: The estimated number of arrivals is more than half of the population of the city, which is about 83,600.
